boundary: run(input) reads the script in place through external interfaces and turns manifest entries into PrecacheEntry values (each revision stays the caller's JS value); Workbox's controller, router, strategies, handler and plugins run as Kotlin classes and suspend functions over external declarations of CacheStorage, Fetch, Request, Response, URL and RegExp, with Workbox's eager promises as host Promises started by coroutines; the output is built as JS objects and arrays, from a coroutine as a Promise.
